messages:
Alex M: FYI seeing a spike of 5xx from the gateway to model-pool-us-east-1. Appears tied to TTL header propagation after yesterday's KV rollout. Can we do a quick traffic swap to a compatible pool?
Jin (oncall): :rotating_light: Confirmed. 5xx from fast-path service, mostly 502/504. Traces show header `x-session-ttl` missing on ~30% of requests -> backend rejects.
Priya R: That's the new TTL header the agents added. It wasn't in the gateway transform for the canary. We have two options: backfill header via gateway or route traffic to pool that doesn't require it.
Alex M: Routing is faster. We can use gwctl to set a temporary header override at the gateway edge to inject `x-session-ttl: 45` for the affected route, then route to the legacy pool. Quick rollback too.
Sam G: +1. Recommend canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% and watch `gateway.5xx_rate` and p95 latency. I can update the dashboard and add an annotation.
Priya R: Watch out: injecting TTL could change cache keys due to TTL-based sharding. Keep TTL low (30-60s). Also ensure we remove the header on rollback.
Alex M: Plan:
1) set override header (10% canary)
2) wait 3 mins (monitor metrics)
3) increase to 50%
4) if metrics stable -> 100%
5) keep override until agents push a fix, then remove it and do controlled agent rollout
Commands: 
```
# gwctl traffic override
gwctl route-set --service fast-path --match "/v1/generate" --header-add "x-session-ttl: 45" --percent 10
```
Jin (oncall): Running step 1 now.
ops-bot: gwctl: started route update 1379 by Jin (oncall) — canary 10% — header x-session-ttl=45
Jin (oncall): canary applied. Monitoring.
Sam G: Metrics look good at 10% after 90s. 5xx down from 3.8% -> 1.2%, p95 latency unchanged.
Priya R: Increase to 50% then. Also add a short-lived tag so Console shows this emergency override in the route details.
Alex M: Doing 50%.
ops-bot: gwctl: route update 1379 progress -> 50%
Jin (oncall): 50% stable. Recommending full cut.
Alex M: Flipping to 100% now. If anything spikes revert by unsetting header or set percent=0.
ops-bot: gwctl: route update 1379 -> 100% complete
deploy-bot: annotate: emergency-traffic-swap created by Alex M; linked incident INC-4821
Sam G: Dashboard annotated, created alert suppression for the maintenance window and added a log retention slice for traces.
Priya R: After upstream agent fix, remove override and run a controlled agent rollout. Add runbook item: always add gateway transform when introducing required headers, and avoid TTL >60s for emergency overrides.
Alex M: Opening follow-ups: PR to add router-match unit tests for header transforms, update the Console UI to show active header overrides, and a short doc for oncall.
Jin (oncall): Will monitor for 30m then hand back to Platform. Nice work everyone :thumbsup:
Alex M: Thanks — I'll capture this in the incident doc and mark the rollback steps explicitly.
Sam G: Thanks team.
Priya R: Closing note: remember to clear the override after agents ship the fix, and run a canary agent rollout to validate.
Jin (oncall): Closing loop — no regression seen in the last 30m. Handing back to platform squad. :white_check_mark:
